trials.claim: Online vector graphic editor with templates and design elements
trials.claimQuote: Online Illustrator & Vector Graphic Editor with Beautiful Templates and Design Elements
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes it as an online vector design app and SVG editor with built-in editable templates and vector design elements. The reviews only complain about template search and wanting more icons, not that templates or elements are absent.

exhibits.quote: I would give it only 3 stars in terms of templates, as it does not offer a precise search function for templates by name, unlike Canva.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports templates are lacking and hard to search, undermining the beautiful templates claim.

exhibits.quote: It needs more Icons but other than that it's been straight forward for me and really useful for a one of cost.
exhibits.argument: Buyer says it needs more icons, undermining the design elements claim.

exhibits.quote: Super User-Friendly Online Vector Design App & SVG Editor
exhibits.argument: Vendor headline directly describes the product as an online vector design app and SVG editor.

exhibits.quote: Drawtify has many built-in design resources, including high-quality editable templates and vector design elements.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the product includes editable templates and vector design elements as built-in resources.

trials.claim: Can create vector logos, infographics, animations, marketing materials, and social media images
trials.claimQuote: Drawtify is a user-friendly online vector graphic design application that allows users to create various graphics such as vector logos, infographics, animations, marketing materials, and social media images.
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms templates for logos, infographics, social media posts and business branding, and the vendor states it has a built-in online animation maker. Reports of export bugs and inability to import .ai/.eps files do not show these graphics cannot be created.

exhibits.quote: Cons: Some bugs and challenges (export quality, working with 'text' in 'text box')
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports export quality bugs and text editing problems, undermining creation claims.

exhibits.quote: I was unable to read or import ".ai" and ".eps" files.
exhibits.argument: Inability to import standard vector formats undermines vector logo creation claim.

exhibits.quote: So many useful templates to get you started like logos, business cards, infographics, social media posts...Templates for almost anything you need for business/branding.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms templates exist for logos, infographics, social media posts and business branding needs.

exhibits.quote: Its built-in online animation maker is very friendly.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the product includes a built-in online animation maker for creating animations.

trials.claim: Available in web-based, Mac, and Windows versions
trials.claimQuote: Drawtify is available in three versions: a web-based online version, a Mac application, and a Windows application.
trials.reasoning: No exhibit shows Mac or Windows versions being available. The exhibits only mention online use and that mobile is not supported, which neither proves nor disproves desktop apps.

exhibits.quote: We’re not just an online illustrator, vector creator or SVG editor.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes product only as online with no mention of Mac or Windows apps.

exhibits.quote: mobile not supported - use a tablet or desktop instead.
exhibits.argument: Access is blocked on some devices, undermining broad availability across versions.
